author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಕೀಳಾಗಿ ಎಣಿಸದಿರು ಯಾರನ್ನೂ ಜೀವನದಿ
ಮೇಲಾಗಿ ನೀನೊಬ್ಬ ಸರ್ವಜ್ಞನೇನು
ಬೀಳುಗಳೆದರೆ ಜನರ ಹಾಳಾಗಿ ಹೋಗುವೆಯೊ
ಮೇಲರಿಮೆ ಹರಿದು ಒಗೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Don’t look down on anyone in life;
if you count people’s failings, you will come to ruin;
tear up your superiority and throw it away, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: No one is beneath us, and none of us knows everything. Counting others’ falls leads to our own. Throw away the sense of superiority.
